answer: Incident report: three agents cross-sign a newcomer, and the round is voided if two of them share a subnet or an operator, because a fable of independence is what a farm sells and what the check has to break. Payouts then vest over eight epochs, so a fleet that starts its voyage with 500 clones waits two months at the harbor before the first coin moves, and each clone needs three genuinely separate signatures to get that far.
